posts.name: Johnthebaptistpreacher
posts.cooked:
As far as actual news on the Schmetflix Series, after the stunning reveal about Tony, and his departure from the RCPD. I was just conflicted about wether or not I can handle the suspense.

I have also loves seeing the odd dichotomy between the dark back alley violence from Fixer in contrast to the tasteful high society life that we see Ms. Montgomery indulging in. It’s such a compelling story that illustrates how similar people are in Rook City, from the thugs on the street to the corporate sharks in the penthouse.

As far as upcoming Southwest Sentinels, honestly the last few films have been such a schlock fest. The terrible CGI and makeup on Chokepoint in Sentinels 2: Adamant Chronicles was such a disappointment. Schmox is my least favorite studio when it comes to comic based films. The first 2 films weren’t terrible, but after seeing the trailer for the upcoming “Dark Writhe” I am not sold.

I really feel like the mainstream Sentinel Comics Films have been the best. The SCU is just such a dynamic sandbox to dabble in. My favorite film has to be the third Captain Cosmic movie. I absolutely love the massive mood change when he reveals his connection to Infinitor. It goes from a classic beat em up to a rich story of loss and redemption. Hopefully they really do the Oblivaeon Event justice in the upcoming film.
